summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-200 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective August 3, 2026, after shareholder approval on April 30, 2026. The consolidation reduced outstanding Class A shares from 119,643,455 to approximately 598,218, with fractional shares rounded up. Authorized capital became USD35,000, comprising 15,750,000 Class A and 1,750,000 Class B shares at USD0.002 par value. Trading continues under symbol LBGJ with new CUSIP G5480M128. This is a routine capital-structure maintenance event, not a special situation.
